name: rocking_horse
description: a wooden rocking horse with a faded red leather saddle. it rocks gently as you pass, though no one touched it. one of its painted eyes seems to follow you. the rockers creak rhythmically, slowly coming to a stop.

params.success_message: as you approach the rocking horse, it stops moving. beneath it, scratched into the wooden floor: 'ellie was here' in a child's handwriting. the scratches are fresh.
